queue.title: Grading queue
queue.description: Writing and Speaking submissions waiting for a teacher. A submission you claim is hidden from the other teachers; past the claim deadline it returns to the queue.
queue.examHint: Leave empty to see every exam you are assigned, or enter a code (for example IELTS).
queue.emptyTitle: Nothing is waiting to be graded
queue.empty: When a learner submits work that needs a teacher, it appears here.
queue.errorTitle: The queue could not be loaded
queue.error: Something went wrong loading the grading queue. Try again.
queue.taken: Another teacher has claimed this submission. The list was refreshed.

grading.title: Grade a submission
grading.description: Read the answer or listen to the recording, look at the AI's result if there is one, then score each criterion. The teacher's score is the official one.
grading.errorTitle: The submission could not be opened
grading.error: This submission could not be loaded. Go back to the queue and try again.
grading.notYours: You have not claimed this submission, or it was returned to the queue. Claim it before grading.
grading.saved: Saved. Another skill still needs grading.
grading.allDone: All graded. The learner gets the official score.
